title: Ask Your Father in Heaven
description: This sermon emphasizes the importance of prayer, highlighting God's infinite strength, righteousness, goodness, wisdom, and love, inviting believers to come and ask Him for good things. It encourages a deep inclination to pray, drawing from Jesus' teachings in Matthew 7:7-11. The sermon unpacks eight encouragements to pray, emphasizing God's promises to respond with good things, the accessibility of God as our Father, and the foundational role of the cross in answering our prayers.
